summary: SuperX AI Technology Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its 2025 share repurchase program and the adoption of a new 2026 program. The company repurchased 2,326,089 ordinary shares at an average net price of US$8.58 per share under the previous US$20 million authorization, which concluded on August 4, 2026. On August 6, 2026, the board authorized a new US$20 million buyback over the next twelve months, citing undervaluation and confidence in long-term growth. Repurchases may occur in open market or privately negotiated transactions under Rule 10b-18 and Rule 10b5-1 plans, with no obligation to buy a specific number of shares. What to watch: execution pace and potential price support.
